node.label: obsolete Heimler syndrome
node.definition: OBSOLETE. A peroxisoome biogenesis disorder characterized by sensorineural hearing loss, enamel hypoplasia of the secondary dentition, nail abnormalities and occasional or late-onset retinal pigmentation abnormalities, in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in peroxisomal biogenesis factor 1 (PEX1) or peroxisomal biogenesis factor 6 (PEX6) genes.
synonyms: bilateral sensorineural hearing loss, enamel hypoplasia and nail defects
sensorineural hearing loss, enamel hypoplasia, and nail abnormalities
